typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchivePath as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string ()
}

source(output(
		memberNumber as double,
		PhoneNumber as double,
		phonesource_iid as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ManualMemberPhonessource
ManualMemberPhonessource derive({Copy of phonesource_iid} = toString(phonesource_iid),
		{Copy of memberNumber} = toString(memberNumber),
		{Copy of PhoneNumber} = toString(PhoneNumber)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		PS_MemberNumber as string,
		PS_PhoneSource_IID as string,
		PS_PhoneNumber as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		PS_MemberNumber = {Copy of memberNumber},
		PS_PhoneSource_IID = {Copy of phonesource_iid},
		PS_PhoneNumber = {Copy of PhoneNumber})) ~> PDSPHONELOADStaging
